cover: Photorealistic architectural photograph taken aboard a cutting-edge working orbital spacecraft that clamps to a space-elevator tether. This vehicle is tall, pressure-rated and incredibly compact. Advanced white ceramic-coated and dove-gray composite pressure-shell liners, thin machined titanium and exposed graphite CFRP primary spars, exact-fit floating access panels with 1-mm reveal gaps, black bonded sapphire instrumentation, subtle serial labels, attention to weight, recessed neutral-white LED channels. Sparse localized wear at real touch points, neutral high-CRI lighting, immaculate engineering. Designer industrial aerospace photography imagine a real 2080s crewed capsule photographed for an engineering journal, not an illustration. Human scale. Strong coherent perspective, soft physically plausible reflections, dramatic Earthshine through multilayer glass; deep shadow plus creamy highlight detail. No steampunk, bronze/brass, rust, Victorian fittings, loose household furniture, decorative fake greebles, generic movie spaceship glowing neon tunnels, human figures, logos or watermarks. A spectacular ultrawide 2.18:1 cinematic establishing photograph from the threshold of the observation cabin, 24mm lens. On the right two-thirds a spectacular large deep-set angular wraparound CUPOLA window with three broad frameless views between thin black structural mullions and sculptural titanium pressure frames, showing a brilliant curved blue Earth, South Pacific islands and cloud swirls under a thin ice-blue atmospheric limb against black space. A dark graphite elevator ribbon with two registration lights can be glimpsed rising physically outside the far right window. At the right foreground a partial silhouette of a sophisticated smoke-blue technical-mesh acceleration seat with a black five-point harness and red-orange pull tab. In the LEFT middle ground a gently canted flush black flight instrument panel wraps around with high-res white amber and cyan flight data, a small machined throttle in a gated quadrant, polished grab recesses. Lower left dark, natural negative space for typography to be added later. Hand-reachable systems, true double walls, neutral engineered elegance. Restrained deep vermilion safety accents. Deliberate large shapes and stillness, high contrast, space exploration and scale. The windows and Earth are luminous, outer hull and interlocking panels feel physical. NO titles, no text overlays. Photograph fills the whole frame.
cloud: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Wide 360-degree equirectangular environmental sky texture for a realistic first-person space elevator simulation. Camera above a vast equatorial ocean cloud deck early in a beautiful clear morning near the top of the troposphere. Lower HALF of image detailed volumetric white and pale warm cumulus mountain ranges, deep slate-blue ocean in gaps. Level horizon on horizontal centerline, upper half subtle cobalt and blue atmosphere. Low morning sunlight coming from the LEFT, delicate warm gold on the clouds, shadows blue. Meteorological aerial photography, high quality photographic detail and natural exposure, horizontal ultrawide 2:1 panorama environment with a level horizon, seamless left/righthand edges when possible. NO aircraft, vehicles, buildings, cables, spacecraft, window frames, graphics, text, lens flares or people. This is the unobstructed view outside a vehicle.
limb: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Photographic outer-space environment panorama, ultrawide 2:1. From high above the equatorial Pacific at several hundred km, facing a sweeping vast, softly CURVED Earth horizon, diagonal only a few degrees, horizon in middle lower HALF. Upper half near-black starless velvet space, very thin luminous turquoise atmospheric layer. The blue ocean, fine scattered cold white cloud systems, a partially sunlit ochre-brown continent disappear into the terminator in lower image. Scientific fidelity, realistic exposure, subtle twilight peach edging at right. NASA large-format orbital photography, spatially majestic, uninterrupted landscape, realistic ocean color, high-frequency detail in clouds. No windows, no lettering, no buildings, equipment, artificial guide rails, watermarks or prominent objects in foreground. A detailed photographic skybox texture.
deep: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Ultra-wide 2:1 orbital environmental panorama for a scientifically grounded interactive ride. A full blue and white Earth seen at geostationary altitude from a space elevator, just smaller than HALF the FRAME HEIGHT, fully within the picture, Earth CENTERED horizontally, centered slightly below the vertical middle in the photograph, heavily gibbous upper left sunlit crescent with realistic enormous swirling white equatorial clouds, Australia/Pacific Ocean, faint turquoise atmosphere against deep blue-black space. Very subtle few stars to the sides. Actual photographic surface texture, very dark sky, no nebula, no dramatic lens flares or spaceship. Natural orbital photography, color film, uncluttered. This is a pure background environment texture, unobstructed, no windows, vehicle, artificial structures, labels, watermarks or text.

A tiny flush-black touch ID reader by hatch. A tethered aramid field tool wallet clips low. Integrated flat crew audio panel, no old telephone or steam valves. Looks aerospace-engineered down to the safety-wire geometry. Full-bleed photo no title, no text overlay.
terminal: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Exterior photograph from the window of a working space elevator at its docking terminal. A true O'Neill cylinder space habitat in geosynchronous orbit in black space, steel cylinder axis running diagonally from the upper left (far cap) to right lower-middle foreground (near end). Giant correctly cylindrical shape, NOT a ring station and NOT a stack of wheels. Alternating longitudinal LAND and LIGHT WINDOW strips, highly intricate fine structural ribs, sunlit platinum-white superstructure, large dark blue and green window strips revealing little longitudinal planted valleys behind glass. Three long angled rectangular mirror wings running alongside, complex docking gantries and smaller tanks radiating from near drum hub. A sunlit blue-white Earth is small in the left lower distant background. Side lit high contrast hard white sun, deep shadows, lightly aged warm metal and realistic paneling. Dark negative space around the station to see the full silhouette, entire station visible, no aircraft/human/foreground window/text/logo. Looks like an IMAX orbital EVA photograph of the real built megastructure, disciplined engineering and strong sense of massive scale. Wide panoramic horizontal 2:1 crop. An external destination photograph, sharp, restrained natural color, quiet awe.
